text: Explain Clean Architecture in Android. How do you structure your packages?
modelAnswer: Clean Architecture separates code into Presentation (UI, ViewModels), Domain (UseCases, Domain Models), and Data (Repositories, API, DB). Dependencies point inward toward Domain.
followUps: What belongs in domain vs data layer?
How do you map data models to domain models?

text: How would you design an offline-first app in Android?
modelAnswer: In an offline-first app, the local Room database serves as the Single Source of Truth. The app loads data from DB immediately while fetching fresh data from network in background.
